_read_me: These are the ONLY treatments with a national reference entry. Every other treatment deliberately has no entry here — see cost_service.py comments for why that's the honest choice rather than filling in a guessed number. PM-JAY/CGHS rates are genuinely the same across all states/UTs (confirmed via nha.gov.in), which is exactly why one national entry can correctly serve all 36 states/UTs instead of fabricating 36 fake variations of a number that doesn't actually vary.

govt.source: Approximate PM-JAY published package rate (national, applies to all states/UTs). Sourced via secondary aggregators (adrine.in, hopehospital.com) referencing the NHA Health Benefit Package schedule, not the primary nha.gov.in PDF directly — verify exact current figure at nha.gov.in before relying on it.
